test_title: PYST 173: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 16th Nov, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Aditi is the daughter of Sanket. Vritti is the daughter of Ankit. Kriti is the mother of Mahi. Neeta is Sanket's wife. Neeta is the mother-in-law of Vritti's mother Kriti. Which of the following statements is **NOT correct**?

options.text: Ankit is the father of Mahi.
Vritti is the sister of Mahi.
Aditi is the daughter of Neeta.
Kriti is the daughter of Sanket.

solution:
The relation followed from given statements is as follows :

Family chart :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d790e27bc814701fb7e9f2b90c1bae1fe27eabb931a2ba4b5ee7a093e7bf7f6.png] 

Family diagram :

1) Aditi is the daughter of Sanket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4ab1be2582472bc5f3b91db04616ab8cb289a0739441aff0b5a171839b82967.png] 

2) Vritti is the daughter of Ankit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4356286544ce1c4386eab3dea02e1625dd516f68ab16d2eca059df7706d4ca42.png] 

3) Kriti is the mother of Mahi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/985dab517b63da28fcf0c33d7285ed37b2840bfcb463c30a81ed6cb6c8e93649.png] 

4) Neeta is Sanket's wife.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d15f623a7586d66a6c6b0f91b9a695a2c553f3eb35222a343b07797134ec8937.png] 

5) Neeta is the mother-in-law of Vritti's mother Kriti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7edd384458cc84afd9c6179a38e9d6e842f61d3e78de8c9312f1614a989505e8.png] 

By checking the given options :

1. Ankit is the father of Mahi → True (From above diagram)

2. Vritti is the sister of Mahi → True (From above diagram)

3. Aditi is the daughter of Neeta → True (From above diagram)

4. Kriti is the daughter of Sanket → False (Here Kriti is Daughter-in-law of Sanket from above diagram hence, False)

∴ Here, 'Kriti is daughter of Sanket' is not correct from given statements.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Kriti is the daughter of Sanket".**
